title: CIA-created UFO news outlet appearing around the time of the Lazar film

tellings.quote: That is a CIA stood up media source.

plain: Around 2018, when a film about a man named Bob Lazar came out, a UFO news outlet appeared online, run from overseas, that was in truth set up by the CIA, the US spy agency. That is the claim of the filmmaker and journalist Jeremy Corbell, who says he has it from named sources and puts it bluntly: "That is a CIA stood up media source." If true, it would mean the spy agency was shaping UFO news from the inside.
